invariant: CommandPackageWithUSymbol accepts both DISPLAY as CODE and CODE as "DISPLAY" for every supported symbol-container keyword, including node, frame, cloud, database, folder, and rectangle. It also accepts the corresponding unquoted display/code form. CODE is cleaned and used as the quark identity; DISPLAY remains the visible group label. Alias direction is presentation syntax and never changes the group identity model.
causal_divergence: Rust now accepts aliases for every recognized symbol keyword, but its single regex models only quoted-or-bare DISPLAY followed by an optional bare CODE. It cannot represent bare CODE followed by quoted DISPLAY, so valid folder and rectangle declarations are skipped and later references materialize a different implicit package/class structure.
planned_change: Parse the two Java alias alternatives explicitly, normalize both into one code/display pair, and then reuse the existing quark-backed package construction path. Preserve the unaliased and DISPLAY-as-CODE behavior. Add parser tests for both directions across symbols, nesting, external relationships, and renamed labels.
